exposure: Experience with interventions and mode of birth
Planned and actual place of birth
cohort: Women of childbearing age in British Columbia, Canada
finding: The Mothers on Respect index (MORi) is a reliable, patient-informed quality and safety indicator that can be used to assess the nature of patient-provider relationships and access to person-centered maternity care.
mod_finding: MORi scores differed by mode of birth.
